processSteps.label: DISCOVER
processSteps.title: Consultation
processSteps.description: Understand the property, users, lifestyle, business needs, budget and timeline. Collect floor plans, photos and reference images.

processSteps.label: MEASURE
processSteps.title: Site Analysis
processSteps.description: Measure the space, identify technical limitations and study light, movement, storage and service points.

processSteps.label: PLAN
processSteps.title: Concept and Planning
processSteps.description: Develop layouts, mood direction, furniture zoning, material strategy and visual references.

processSteps.label: SELECT
processSteps.title: Material Selection
processSteps.description: Shortlist finishes, hardware, lighting, furniture and surface details according to budget and durability.

processSteps.label: BUILD
processSteps.title: Execution
processSteps.description: Coordinate site work, vendors, procurement, fabrication, installation and quality checks.

processSteps.label: HANDOVER
processSteps.title: Handover
processSteps.description: Review the finished space, document care guidance and close remaining practical details.

projects.description: A quietly tailored family living room where warm mineral tones, generous seating and integrated storage create an easy setting for everyday life.
projects.scope: Living-room planning, seating layout, media joinery, display storage, lighting and soft-furnishing direction
projects.brief: The family wanted their main room to feel composed enough for guests and relaxed enough for daily use, with a clear place for media, books and objects collected over time.
projects.challenge: The room needed substantial storage and comfortable seating without losing the openness, daylight and calm visual rhythm that make a living room feel generous.
projects.solution: A low, linear furniture plan is paired with integrated joinery, layered ambient lighting and a restrained sand-and-timber palette to give the room warmth, order and flexibility.
projects.name: Sandstone Residence

projects.description: A practical family kitchen that brings prep, cooking, cleaning and casual dining into one clear, efficient sequence.
projects.scope: Kitchen planning, appliance integration, pantry storage, breakfast counter, task lighting and durable finish specification
projects.brief: The household needed a kitchen that could handle daily cooking, school-day breakfasts and weekly stocking without turning the counter or circulation route into a bottleneck.
projects.challenge: The compact footprint had to accommodate a complete appliance set, generous dry storage and two-person movement while keeping the room bright and visually calm.
projects.solution: Full-height pantry units, an integrated appliance wall, continuous worktops and under-cabinet lighting create a functional kitchen with easy reach, clean lines and lasting materials.
projects.name: Gurgaon Family Kitchen

projects.description: A considered living-room renewal that preserves the familiarity of a family home while improving light, storage and day-to-day comfort.
projects.scope: Living-room reconfiguration, custom storage, lighting renewal, finish selection and furniture placement
projects.brief: The owners wanted a more current, practical living room without erasing the warmth and memories already held in the home.
projects.challenge: New storage, lighting and seating had to improve function within the existing shell, while the renovation needed to remain measured and minimally disruptive.
projects.solution: A lighter material palette, edited architectural details and purpose-built storage simplify the room, improve circulation and retain its lived-in sense of character.
projects.name: Pitampura Family Home

projects.description: A neighbourhood café designed for an unhurried daytime rhythm, with tactile finishes, soft light and a clear operational backbone.
projects.scope: Customer journey, seating mix, service counter, lighting concept, material palette and hospitality detailing
projects.brief: The ambition was a café that feels inviting from the first coffee of the day through a busy evening service, without compromising the team’s speed or the guest’s comfort.
projects.challenge: A compact floor plate had to balance queueing, counter service, table density and staff movement while still offering guests distinct places to meet, work or pause.
projects.solution: A legible counter sequence, varied seating zones, warm pools of light and robust natural finishes create an atmosphere-led café that remains efficient at peak hours.
projects.name: Courtyard Cafe

projects.description: A daylight-led living room that pairs relaxed seating with disciplined storage, creating a polished space that still feels easy to use.
projects.scope: Living-room zoning, seating selection, media wall, concealed storage, decorative lighting and styling direction
projects.brief: The family asked for a welcoming social room that could host visitors comfortably, support quiet downtime and keep everyday clutter out of sight.
projects.challenge: The media wall, seating group and storage needed to work as one composition without interrupting daylight or crowding the circulation path.
projects.solution: Low-profile furniture, a quietly detailed media wall, concealed cabinetry and layered decorative lighting create a refined living room with an open, lived-in quality.
projects.name: Sunlit Living Room

projects.description: A compact apartment living room made to feel more generous through disciplined planning, visually light furniture and storage that works in the background.
projects.scope: Living-room layout, compact seating, dining integration, media storage, lighting and space-optimisation strategy
projects.brief: The owners wanted the apartment’s main room to comfortably support family time and guests while remaining bright, low-maintenance and easy to move through.
projects.challenge: Every piece had to earn its place: seating, dining, media and storage needed to coexist in a limited footprint without making the room feel overfilled.
projects.solution: A compact furniture plan, full-height storage and a light-toned material palette make the living room feel clearer, more adaptable and noticeably more spacious.
projects.name: Noida Apartment

projects.description: A streamlined modular kitchen that combines serious everyday utility with a crisp, calm material expression.
projects.scope: Modular cabinetry, work-triangle planning, tall-unit storage, appliance integration, lighting and surface specification
projects.brief: The household wanted a kitchen that keeps cookware, provisions and appliances organised, with a layout that feels intuitive for both quick meals and longer cooking sessions.
projects.challenge: The sink, hob, refrigerator and storage had to be placed for efficient movement in a compact plan, while the cabinetry needed to avoid feeling heavy or overly technical.
projects.solution: A clear work triangle, integrated appliances, full-height storage and concealed task lighting create a highly usable kitchen with a clean, enduring finish palette.
projects.name: Gurgaon Modular Kitchen

projects.description: A villa living-room renovation that trades ornament for proportion, texture and a more relaxed sense of everyday luxury.
projects.scope: Living-room renovation, architectural detailing, lighting renewal, furniture layout and material palette development
projects.brief: The owners wanted the main living spaces to feel quieter and more contemporary while retaining the generosity, warmth and personal character of the villa.
projects.challenge: The renewed living room had to bring together areas of different scales and retain useful existing construction without carrying forward a visually busy language.
projects.solution: A consistent floor and wall palette, edited detailing, softer lighting and tailored furniture zoning give the living spaces a calm, cohesive and lasting character.
projects.name: Warm Minimal Villa

projects.description: A compact café-dining interior built around an intimate guest experience, warm evening atmosphere and a plan that supports efficient service.
projects.scope: Café-dining layout, seating density, counter planning, lighting strategy, finish selection and guest-flow coordination
projects.brief: The concept required a memorable, welcoming dining space that could achieve useful capacity without making tables feel compressed or service feel exposed.
projects.challenge: Table spacing, counter activity, back-of-house movement and visual impact all competed for a narrow footprint and had to be resolved as one guest experience.
projects.solution: A disciplined seating plan, layered wall finishes and focused lighting create a café interior that feels intimate and expressive while keeping circulation and service clear.
projects.name: Compact Restaurant

hero.title: A design and execution studio for spaces that need to feel considered, not crowded.
hero.text: Based in Pitampura, Delhi, Design Essentials works across Delhi NCR to create residential and commercial interiors with a balance of aesthetics, usability and site-level practicality.

story.title: Design is only successful when the finished space works in real life.
story.text: Our role is to connect ideas with execution. That means understanding how the space will be used, planning the technical details early, selecting materials carefully and coordinating the site so the final result remains faithful to the approved concept.
story.alt: Architectural home exterior and interior composition

values.title: Measured luxury
values.text: Premium does not mean loud. We use proportion, material and detail to create restraint and comfort.

values.title: Practical planning
values.text: Storage, lighting, ventilation, movement and maintenance are planned before the visual layer is finalised.

values.title: One accountable journey
values.text: Design, sourcing, site coordination and handover remain connected through one organised process.

belief.text: This is the principle behind every residential, commercial and renovation project.
